bundle.title: Terluna Moon Terraforming Knowledge Bundle
bundle.scope: reconstructed project canon plus quantitative engineering expansion
bundle.limitation: The full historical conversation was not available as a verbatim export.

project.name: Terluna
project.goal: Maintained breathable atmosphere, regional hydrosphere, engineered biosphere, human settlement and atmospheric flight
project.feasibility_status: Far-future research and worldbuilding program; not proven or near-term.

recovered_canon: The terraformed Moon is called Terluna.
The long lunar day-night cycle remains a defining environmental feature.
Practical dawn or dusk transition is about five hours.
Organisms store resources and adapt to prolonged illumination and darkness.
Aerial and gliding ecology is a major Terluna feature.
The top-of-troposphere/lower-stratosphere worldbuilding band is approximately 35–45 km.
Atmospheric gravity waves can be launched by mountains and terminator fronts.
High-altitude life is sparse and can include microbes or engineered radiation-hard algal films.
High-altitude platforms can support farside astronomy and nearside Earthlight photometry.
Atmospheric layers use descriptive names rather than L1–L5.

corrections.rule: Use about five hours for each practical dawn or dusk transition; do not use 30 hours.
corrections.geometry: Five hours corresponds to about 2.54 degrees of solar motion and is included within the 29.53-day cycle.

corrections.rule: Do not call atmospheric bands L1–L5; those labels are Lagrange points.
Atmospheric gravity waves are buoyancy waves, not gravitational waves in spacetime.

why_it_might_work: Gravity can support a collisional lunar atmosphere for nonzero periods.
Published ancient-atmosphere and escape work shows atmosphere lifetime is state-dependent rather than instant by definition.
The Moon receives Earthlike solar flux.
The atmosphere and regional water inventory can provide planetary heat storage and day-night transport.
Lunar rock supplies oxygen and construction materials.
Low gravity strongly favors atmospheric flight and large structures.
hard_gates: Multigenerational health at 0.16 g and artificial-gravity dose.
Stable hydrology, soil and nutrient cycles.
Science, heritage, resident and international legitimacy.
fallback: Stop at sealed cities and paraterraformed basins if any global hard gate fails.
